title: Vintage Pearl White

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Tailored for classic roadsters and urban cruising, the Premier Vintage Pearl White is crafted for classic motorcycle enthusiasts seeking unrestricted peripheral sightlines. Its High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) shell tips the scales at a featherweight 1102g, channeling boundary-layer airflow to maintain a ~96 dB acoustic cabin profile while meeting ECE 22.06 impact standards. The interior features a plush, moisture-wicking crown liner shaped for Intermediate Oval head shapes, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for effortless warm-weather riding.

product_details.description: Authentic retro open face with chrome trim and custom paint options.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for open-face fitment with a vintage aesthetic; requires cheek pads adjustment for optimal comfort on extended rides.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Premier Vintage Pearl White: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.

introduction: Positioned in Premier's Open Face lineup, the Vintage Pearl White brings Global Premium engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified ECE 22.06 track safety.
story:
The Premier Vintage Pearl White represents Premier's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~96 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) Open Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Premier Vintage Pearl White delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
